results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 14 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (296 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is info.nl (3 authors), with 79% of the 189 commits whose organisation is known; 36% of the commits come from 7 of 17 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 51 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 55 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment or review by someone other than the author, over the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13. 7 got a response; 8 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment by someone other than the author, over the 15 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13. 1 got a response; 14 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 14 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 26 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-10-29. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
